_note: Visual changes a pull request declares intended. Read by web/visual/baseline.mjs in verify mode, and by the React admin visual regression job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. An entry says: on branch X, screen Y is MEANT to look different, here is who decided that, when, and why. Only entries whose `branch` matches the branch being verified are live, so an entry that has merged to main is history and approves nothing on a later pull request. Every field is required: screen (one name, no globs), branch, reason (at least 10 characters), approvedBy, date (YYYY-MM-DD). `notes` is the one optional field. Anything else, including an unknown field name or a screen the surface does not have, fails the verify with exit 3 rather than sitting there silently doing nothing. Approve only after looking at the diff overlay the run uploads: the artifact is `react-visual-regression`, and regression.md links every changed screen to its own picture.
